definitions.CLOSED: Every currently implemented route in the stated operation scope enters one reviewed terminal-independent application boundary; missing future adapters do not make a current route mixed.
definitions.MIXED: A reviewed application boundary exists, but at least one current route, lifecycle phase, or conflicting evidence still leaves ownership outside that boundary.
definitions.LEGACY: Review proved that the command or presentation layer remains the effective owner of application policy.
definitions.N/A: Review and tests proved that the application-boundary question does not apply to this operation.
definitions.UNREVIEWED: No route-closure conclusion has been made; this is not evidence that the operation is legacy.

add.reason: The typed batch, authority, mutation, CLI, TUI, public, and agent routes are verified against one application/runtime boundary.

atomize.reason: Analysis, saved review, reanalysis, both Apply directions, recovery, and public projection are verified as one structural lifecycle.

compare.reason: CLI, TUI, Python, agent, and MCP routes share one targetless Run, exact Open, and version-bound Refresh lifecycle with production cache ordering and no Context Apply.

distill.reason: CLI, TUI, public, agent, MCP, Ground, provider, and prepared-result routes share the reviewed Distill application contract.

elaborate.reason: CLI, TUI, public, agent, MCP, Ground, provider, and prepared-result routes share the reviewed Elaborate application contract.

embed.reason: The mutable relationship plan, freeze, CAS Apply, plain CLI, and interactive setup point to one terminal-independent use case.

fit.reason: General and Ground Fit routes share typed application/runtime execution and independent plain and TUI projections.

init.reason: Ordinary Context initialization has one typed terminal-free transaction and independent exact-name CLI/TUI presenters; Study initialization remains a separate operation.

merge.reason: Direct and recursive Merge planning, review, application, and presentation use the same frozen typed plan and runtime.

meld.reason: CLI, TUI, Python, and agent routes share typed Start, Restart, saved-turn, cache/provider, CAS, and Apply lifecycles with exact/equivalent/projected reuse and one reviewed-session version contract.

pwd.reason: The only current route is a typed terminal-independent current-Context read with a one-line CLI presenter.

query.reason: Ordinary, granted, and query-only families plus CLI, TUI, public, and agent projections have a verified operation package.

resolve.reason: Direct-Memory Fit repair exposes CLI, TUI, public, agent, and MCP projections over one typed analysis, exact replay, authority, and checkpointed Apply boundary.

sever.reason: Analysis, cache reuse, saved-session review, destination revision, and Apply execute through typed application/runtime boundaries.

summarize.reason: Direct and recursive reads share one terminal-independent application result with independent plain and TUI presenters.

find.reason: Search and materialization are verified, but the progress ledger still names Find dialogue as an unclosed route.

update.reason: Apply policy and recovery are verified, but the complete Update application slice is still recorded as not started.
